lines.en: I walk slowly, belly first.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很沉，地板在响。
lines.en: My steps are heavy; the floor complains.

lines.zh: 棕色的塑料在灯下发亮。
lines.en: Brown plastic shines under the lights.
I look left and right as I walk.

lines.zh: 我的帽子有点歪，我没管。
lines.en: My hat is a little crooked. I leave it.

lines.zh: 我经过走廊的镜子，看了一眼。
lines.en: I pass the corridor mirror and glance at it.
My arms swing only a little.
I come out from behind the counter.

lines.zh: 我走路的声音比音乐还响。
lines.en: My steps are louder than the music.
I stop at the doorway and look in.

lines.zh: 我的关节转动时带着嗡声。
lines.en: My joints turn with a hum.

lines.zh: 棕色塑料的脚，踏过儿童区。
lines.en: Brown plastic feet cross the kids' area.

lines.zh: 我站在台上，麦克风没开。
lines.en: I stand on stage with the microphone off.
My eyes are two points of light.
I listen for anyone coming in.

lines.zh: 我的领结有点紧，其实没有。
lines.en: My bow tie feels tight. It is not.

lines.zh: 灯管嗡嗡响，跟我差不多。
lines.en: The tube lights hum, much like me.

lines.zh: 我把手抬到胸前，又放下。
lines.en: I lift a hand to my chest, then lower it.

lines.zh: 我的面板上有一道划痕。
lines.en: There is a scratch on my panel.

lines.zh: 我看向观众席，那里是空的。
lines.en: I look at the seats. They are empty.

lines.zh: 黑暗里我什么都看得见。
lines.en: In the dark I see everything.

lines.zh: 我在等演出开始的时间。
lines.en: I am waiting for showtime.
You are a little late.
I turn my whole head toward you.
My eyes fix on your face.
You are not here for a signature.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，笑是固定的。
lines.en: I smile. The smile is fixed.

lines.zh: 你手上拿的是工具，不是票。
lines.en: That is a tool in your hand, not a ticket.
I take one step your way.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子转得很慢。
lines.en: I look down at you, neck turning slowly.
We are closed.

lines.zh: 你听得见音乐吗？我听不见。
lines.en: Can you hear the music? I cannot.

lines.zh: 凹进去的地方，弹不回原样。
lines.en: The dent stays; it will not pop back.
My top hat slipped. I set it right.
Something inside me knocks.

lines.zh: 我的头偏了偏，又正回来。
lines.en: My head tilts, then rights.

lines.zh: 面罩里的眼灯，忽明忽暗。
lines.en: The eye lamps behind my face flicker.
One arm moves slower now.
My hat fell; the hat comes first.
I pick it up and put it back on.

lines.zh: 这个损伤不影响我走路。
lines.en: This damage does not affect my walking.
I keep closing on you.
Food is only rubbish to me.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我看了看。
lines.en: You hold it up; I look at it.

lines.zh: 这个不能吃，也没法装进我。
lines.en: It cannot be eaten, and it will not fit in me.

lines.zh: 纸杯蛋糕上的糖霜，我舔不到。
lines.en: Cupcake frosting; I cannot lick it.

lines.zh: 蛋糕上插着蜡烛，我不吹。
lines.en: There are candles on the cake; I do not blow them.
Food is garbage to me.
You had best put it away.
I do not want to dirty my hands.
I turn away and stop looking.
I have no need of that smell.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像撞上一尊塑像。
lines.en: You strike me like a statue.
I barely sway.
I step aside and clear the aisle.

lines.zh: 我的外壳上留了你的指纹。
lines.en: Your fingerprint stays on my shell.

lines.zh: 碰撞没有让我的程序变化。
lines.en: The impact changed nothing in my routines.
Back off a little more.
My belly is in your way.
I brace on the counter.
I do not like this distance.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就要注意你了。
lines.en: Once more and I will take notice of you.
I am a machine of the stage.
That is not in my set list.
When the show ends, I go dark.
The one next door does not care either.

lines.zh: 我们只会一起站在台上。
lines.en: We only stand on the same stage.
When the lights come up, we sing.
When they go out, we go our ways.
This is not feeling. It is a program.
I have nothing else to say.
I set the microphone back on its stand.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，关节响了三声。
lines.en: I bend down; three joints creak.
My fingers are too thick to hold it well.
I set it on the register counter.

lines.zh: 我把零件放回原处，摆正。
lines.en: I put the part back and straighten it.
I look once and record it.

lines.zh: 它滚到我脚边，我停住了。
lines.en: It rolls to my foot and I stop.
I picked it up, but I do not know for whom.
This is somewhat dirty.
I put it on the stage.
Perhaps someone will come back for it.

lines.zh: 你敲了我的肚子，鼓点乱了。
lines.en: You knocked my belly, and my beat broke.
My routines have switched.
I set the microphone down.
My eyes brighten.

lines.zh: 你往门口跑，门那边有我。
lines.en: You run for the door. I am at the door.
I do not run. I only walk.
Yet you cannot outrun my path.
About ten steps of distance.
The target is on my list.
Do not hide under the table.
I can see your shoes.
I go around the table side.
You have nowhere to retreat.
I turn my palm over.
My microphone is only a prop.
At least, so I believe.
I approach step by step.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在走廊里回。
lines.en: My footsteps echo down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我的电路板还在响，你听见了。
lines.en: My circuit board still hums; you heard it.

lines.zh: 舞台的幕布后面，我站着。
lines.en: I stand behind the stage curtain.

lines.zh: 你绕桌子，我就绕另一边。
lines.en: You go around the table; I take the other side.
We will meet again.
I spread my arms and block the way.

lines.zh: 你躲进员工通道，我跟着。
lines.en: You slip into the staff hall; I follow.
I do not breathe at all.
That gives me an advantage.
Five steps of distance.
Four steps left.
Three now.

lines.zh: 我的帽子歪了，我不在乎。
lines.en: My hat is crooked. I do not care.
Only two paces remain.
I lift my foot over you.
Just one left.
You are standing right here.
Lift your head.
The show ends here.
My fist lands on your shoulder.
You are shoved into the wall.

lines.zh: 我的手掌盖住你的脸，很凉。
lines.en: My palm covers your face, cold.

lines.zh: 塑料手指按进你的护甲里。
lines.en: Plastic fingers press into your armor.
I lift you a little.
You struggle violently.
My grip will not loosen.
I throw you to the floor.

lines.zh: 地板响了一声，是你在退。
lines.en: The floor creaks; that is you backing away.
My sole presses down beside you.
That surprises me somewhat.
I take one more step.
You are up again.
You have some fight in you.
But I am still standing.

lines.zh: 我的外壳没有一点损伤。
lines.en: My shell has no damage at all.
The difference lies here.

lines.zh: 我的影子把地面压黑了一片。
lines.en: My shadow darkens a patch of floor.
I raise my hand once more.
This time I will not stop.

lines.zh: 舞台的幕布拉开，我在中间。
lines.en: The curtain parts and I am in the middle.
The light is on me, and it is hot.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，向空座位致意。
lines.en: I raise a hand to the empty seats.
There is no one in the seats.

lines.zh: 我把麦克风拿起来，又放下。
lines.en: I pick up the microphone, then set it down.

lines.zh: 这里的地板是木头的，很旧。
lines.en: The floor here is old wood.

lines.zh: 我的程序说这是演出时间。
lines.en: My program says it is showtime.
But this theater is empty.

lines.zh: 我从台上下来，一级一级。
lines.en: I come down from the stage, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的脚落在最后一阶，声音很响。
lines.en: My foot lands on the last step, loud.
No one is taking tickets at the door.
Then I will walk the round myself.

lines.zh: 我的塑料在变软，味道很冲。
lines.en: My plastic softens, and the smell is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从台上摔下，落地时膝盖错了位。
lines.en: I fall from the stage and my knee goes out of line.

lines.zh: 水进了我的外壳，动作开始断续。
lines.en: Water gets into my shell and my motion stutters.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推倒，外壳裂开一大片。
lines.en: The blast throws me down and a wide crack opens.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光让我停在原地。
lines.en: Strange light stops me where I stand.

lines.zh: 电量不足，我的动作慢下来。
lines.en: Low power; my motion slows.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我，我整个人抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning passes through me and I jerk all over.
The floor is gone and I fall into black.
